HostRxFrame.description: Received host-link frame as rebuilt by bms_frame_parse_legacy_4168 (4148/4168). Offsets are relative to 0x20000929.

fields.name: magic
fields.description: Frame start byte, 0x5A or 0xA5, probably the magic of the last received frame. The parser stores the received byte here at one step of its state machine.

fields.name: command
fields.description: Command byte of the frame. bms_comm_await_reply_cmd03 accepts 0x03 and bms_auth_verify_response accepts 0x1D.

fields.name: type_count
fields.description: Second header byte, copied from the high byte of the parser's 16-bit header word at 0x200001BE. The high nibble is the reply type: 1 for a command 0x03 reply, 4 for a command 0x1D reply. The low nibble is probably the record count.

fields.name: reply_words
fields.description: Four 32-bit reply words, each rebuilt from four received bytes in reversed order. Word 0 is the first payload word, which bms_comm_await_reply_cmd03 copies into its context at +0x08. The auth check compares all four words with a 16-byte value derived from bms_auth_key_block.

BmsTelemRecord.description: One 16-byte telemetry record of the 4130/4139 and 4148/4168 tables. Used by bms_telem11_records and bms_telem16_records.

fields.name: stamp
fields.description: Tick time (bms_tick_get) of the last refresh of this record, written by the block-fill routine.

fields.name: can_id
fields.description: Standard CAN message ID of the frame, set by the scheduler init and read when the record is sent.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Send period in units of 100 ms (5 = 500 ms, 20 = 2 s), set by the scheduler init. The scheduler sends the record when this period has elapsed.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Eight data bytes of the CAN frame, packed from the state block for this record's ID by the block-fill routine.

fields.name: spare
fields.description: Byte 15 of the record. No code in the batch 22 to 24 packets touches it.
